## Overview

This project packages a clinical pharmacokinetic analysis of midazolam as a reproducible, self-contained report. The emphasis is on a clean, transparent analysis-to-report pipeline: the analysis is authored once and rendered to a shareable web report, so the narrative, figures and tables stay in sync with the underlying code.

## Why midazolam

Midazolam is a short-acting benzodiazepine and a widely used clinical **CYP3A probe substrate**, which makes its pharmacokinetics a natural, well-characterised subject for a clinical PK reporting exercise and for illustrating a reproducible reporting workflow.

## Approach

The analysis follows the same reproducibility principles as the other projects in this portfolio: a scripted, version-controlled workflow in R, figures and tables generated directly from the analysis, and a Quarto report as the single published deliverable rendered to GitHub Pages.
